description: Dense-only baseline (SPEC.md Phase 1 exit criteria): Docling parsing, bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings, pgvector HNSW cosine search, no sparse/RRF/reranking yet (Phase 2). Every improvement from here on is measured as a delta vs this config (SPEC.md §7.2).

corpus.source: arXiv LLM/RAG papers, discovered via arXiv API (scripts/seed_demo_corpus.py)

golden_set.note: unanswerable items are not scored by scripts/run_eval.py yet — abstention lands in Phase 4

generation_latency_observed_seconds.note: CPU inference on the 8GB local profile (implementation-plan.md §2.E), full ~6000-token context, non-streaming. Not yet optimized — that's Phase 2/8.
